name: What is the typical cost for professional installation of a lever style kitchen faucet?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost for professional installation of a lever style kitchen faucet?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost for professional installation of a lever style kitchen faucet can vary. It typically ranges from $150 to $400 for labor, not including the faucet itself. Factors influencing the price include the complexity of the installation, removal of an old faucet, any necessary plumbing modifications, and your specific location within the Bay Area. Some contractors might charge an hourly rate, while others offer a flat fee. It's always best to get a detailed quote from a local contractor before starting the work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional installation costs typically range from $150-$400 for labor, varying based on complexity and location in the Bay Area.
